_howto: Add a new entry at the TOP. Bump 'version' and players who haven't seen it get a notification once. The Discord bot posts new entries automatically.

releases.title: Friends, Notifications & Controllers
changes: Friend requests now need accepting — no more instant adds
Notification centre with toasts for requests and lobby invites
Lobby invites: invite friends straight into your match
Full controller support — A to flap, Start to play, bumpers to switch tabs
Fixed players stacking on top of each other in multiplayer
Arrows now show who's ahead or behind, and by how many pipes
Host permissions actually work now (kick / settings)
Cleaner UI — the button stack is now a compact icon bar

releases.title: Ranked & Spectating
changes: Casual and Competitive queues with seven rank tiers
Coin Rush mode with a 5 minute timer
Levelling to 50 with XP from scores and wins
